query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Create short dog-themed videos, analyze channel and trend performance, upload and manage YouTube Shorts, and inspect Instagram posting context.
query_ground_truth.intent: Upload, publish, and manage short-form videos on YouTube.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm final title/description/tags/categoryId and privacyStatus, and get explicit approval before any privacyStatus="public" using YOUTUBE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD_VIDEO (public-impact).

[Required] [Prerequisite]: Ensure the upload input is a staged videoFile {name,mimetype,s3key}; if the source isn’t already uploadable, stage it via COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH (retry with a smaller export if staging hits limits).
[Required] [Step]: Upload the Short using YOUTUBE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD_VIDEO (primary upload) and store response.data.video.id (videoId) for follow-on actions.

[Optional (if processing/visibility confirmation is needed)] [Next Step]: Verify using YOUTUBE_GET_VIDEO_DETAILS_BATCH; if it returns no items soon after upload, wait briefly and re-check using YOUTUBE_VIDEO_DETAILS (single videoId).

[Optional (if post-upload changes or rollback are needed)] [Next Step]: Update metadata/privacy using YOUTUBE_UPDATE_VIDEO, set a thumbnail using YOUTUBE_UPDATE_THUMBNAIL, or remove the upload using YOUTUBE_DELETE_VIDEO (explicit delete confirmation).
[Fallback (if YOUTUBE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD_VIDEO fails for technical/non-quota reasons)] [Fallback]: Retry upload using YOUTUBE_UPLOAD_VIDEO (alternate upload path) and store the returned videoId.
known_pitfalls: [YOUTUBE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD_VIDEO] Remote-only/non-staged inputs often fail with HTTP 403/404; videoFile must be s3key-backed with {name,mimetype,s3key}.
[YOUTUBE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD_VIDEO] HTTP 400 quota/daily upload limit or HTTP 401 readiness/scope issues won’t resolve with simple retries; address limits/permissions first.
[YOUTUBE_GET_VIDEO_DETAILS_BATCH] Can return HTTP 200 with no items right after upload due to processing lag; re-check after a short delay or use YOUTUBE_VIDEO_DETAILS.
[YOUTUBE_UPDATE_THUMBNAIL] Can fail if the image is over ~2MB or return HTTP 403 if thumbnail permission is missing.
[YOUTUBE_UPLOAD_VIDEO] Expects file-path style input; passing multipart-style videoFile keys or misnaming fields triggers validation errors.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Stage a remotely hosted video into an s3key-backed videoFile for YOUTUBE_MULTIPART_UPLOAD_VIDEO
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import urllib.request,tempfile
req=urllib.request.Request(remote_source,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r, tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) as f:
    f.write(r.read()); p=f.name
res,err=upload_local_file(p)
video_file=None if err else {'name':'video','mimetype':'video/mp4','s3key':(res or {}).get('s3key')}
```

YOUTUBE_GET_VIDEO_DETAILS_BATCH.description: Retrieves multiple YouTube video resource parts in a single batch call. Use when you need cohort-level metrics for many videos to reduce quota usage and latency.

hl.description: Language for localized metadata (snippet.localized); IETF language tag, e.g., 'en'.

id.description: List of YouTube video IDs to retrieve. At least one video ID is required. Accepts a list or comma-separated string. Also accepts 'videoIds' as an alias. The YouTube API limits each request to 50 video IDs; if more are provided, they will be automatically split into multiple requests and the results merged.

parts.description: Video resource properties to include. At least one part is required. Accepts a list of parts or a comma-separated string. Also accepts 'part' (singular) as an alias. Valid parts: snippet, contentDetails, statistics, status, player, topicDetails, recordingDetails, fileDetails, processingDetails, suggestions, liveStreamingDetails, localizations, paidProductPlacementDetails, id. Defaults to ['snippet', 'statistics'] if not specified.
